recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-46072 unless future build tooling changes how standards-status markup is generated.
issue_request: FHIR-46072 said packages.html was labelled Informative despite containing mandatory SHALL text. The Applied/Persuasive with Modification resolution was to change the page status to Normative in R6.
initial_application: The R6 normative-status sweep in commit 270e0ceb changed source/packages.html from Informative to Normative, and the explicit FHIR-46072 commit 014b497 changed the page table class from colsi to colsn so the markup matches the Normative label.
additional_context: source/packages.html is in build scope because source/hierarchy.xml lists packages.html as the NPM Packages page and publish.ini has an active packages.html entry. FHIR-I minutes for 2024-06-24 corroborate the 8-0-0 vote to change the page to Normative, and the Jira-linked Zulip thread only discusses how to apply the Normative page marking.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already implements the requested Normative status and bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no contrary later decision.
